newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P says changes outlook of Ricoh to positive.
newsitem.headline: S&P says changes outlook of Ricoh to positive.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday that it has changed its rating outlook for Ricoh Co Ltd to positive from stable.
The rating agency has also affirmed Ricoh's and its related entities' long-term ratings of A minus (A-) and short-term ratings of A2.

S&P said the revision reflected Ricoh's improving market position based on its strength in digital and networking technology. S&P said it would consider upgrading Ricoh's ratings if it can augment its position with improved competitiveness and sustainable progress.

Meanwhile, the affirmed ratings reflected Ricoh's leading position in the domestic office copier market, an extensive sales and maintenance network, and strong capital structure. But it is constrained by a comparatively narrow product portfolio in office automation equipment and is less globally diversified than its major competitors.
